Name: (CP) Cute Possum Opossum Pet Retexture
Author: muteSnoot
Description:
[center]

This is a fix to a mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/baristarulesgood]Baristarulesgood[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PashaWithHat]PashaWithHat[/url], you no longer need to replace game image files with the possum file, just download the mod and unzip it into the mods file (content patcher required).

The possum is now available for selection when starting a new game!
The adoption event cut scene will play by the 20th day where you will receive the possum as a pet.
You can also purchase the possum at Marnie's shop.
It has it's own animations and sounds distinct from other pets.
